title: Equivalent fractions · study notes
source: Original elementary arithmetic brief; verified by cross multiplication.
copy:
Exact title: "Equivalent fractions". Exact subtitle: "Different numbers. The same amount.". Body copy (verbatim):
Multiply the numerator and denominator by the same nonzero number.
1/2 = 2/4 = 4/8
The whole must stay the same size.
Small sticky note copy: "Changing only the denominator changes the value.".
Diagram: Three perfectly equal-length horizontal fraction strips stacked vertically: first divided into exactly 2 equal parts with 1 shaded; second into exactly 4 with 2 shaded; third into exactly 8 with 4 shaded. Shaded regions align at the halfway point. Labels 1/2, 2/4, 4/8. Separate small worked calculation 2/3 = 4/6 with multiply-by-2 arrows at top and bottom.
